verdict.rationale: Ledgy has a documented OAuth 2.0 API, but the only operations evidenced are `auth`, `companyCaptable` and `companyTransactions`, all of which read data, with paging and change-only retrieval. Most UI capabilities have no API equivalent in the evidence: granting, vesting, contract signing, reporting, compliance, trading/settlement and permissions. Even service-account creation is done in the UI, and the probes found no published OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: write/mutation operations, API coverage of granting/vesting/documents/reports/trading/permissions, programmatic service-account management, a published API spec, and any evidence of UI–API parity.
